banner: SYNTHETIC / SIMULATION - NOT VALIDATED ON REAL DATA

compression_factor.note: Only the slow ground-settlement process is time-compressed (240 s stands for 24 h at 360x, a PLACEHOLDER label); IMU noise, piezo vibration, LiDAR sweeps, packet loss, and 5 s windows run in uncompressed 1x sensor time.

yaw_sensitivity.summary_note: Evaluated across 5 compass perturbation conditions (sd_0deg, sd_5deg, sd_10deg, sd_20deg, single_node_45deg) plus the yaw-free v2 baseline. v3 RF preserves its advantage up to 10 deg SD; at 20 deg SD its test detection advantage disappears, and a single-node 45 deg blunder spikes gradual <-> sensor_fault confusions from 39 to 84.

shape_mismatch.summary_note: Five synthetic surface shapes matched on peak slope (gaussian_control, asymmetric, two_basin, trough_panel, planar_slope). Asymmetric is handled without loss; two_basin causes mild degradation; trough_panel concentrates tilt on a single corner rim (increasing sensor_fault confusion 3.3x on RF); planar_slope has parallel tilts with no convergence point (increasing gradual->sensor_fault confusion 3.0x on RF and 7.5x on LR).

literature_checks.summary_note: Part B1 (high tilt 3-6 deg and 6-12 deg): ThresholdRuleClassifier's hard-coded 3.5 deg implausible-tilt cutoff misclassifies 39%-68% of gradual windows as sensor_fault and misses 93%-100% of rapid runs in 6-12 deg, while RF misclassifies 55.5% of 6-12 deg gradual windows as rapid. Part B2 (realistic depth H=50-300 m, PLACEHOLDER tan(beta)=1.5-2.5 grid): isotropic basins centred within +-1.5 R_net keep sharp radial convergence, though LR gradual detection drops to 0.00 at H=300 m, tanB=1.5.

timescale_audit.summary_note: At the frozen 360x compression factor (240 s = 24 h), 97.6% (161/165) of gradual runs exceed the rough 0.1 deg/day 30-day longwall order-of-magnitude reference (median 0.763 deg/day, 7.63x faster). Relabelling a run as 30 days (10,800x) changes ONLY the Definition A slow-process false-alarm rate, never the simulated sensor data, model scores, or Definition B sensor-time false-alarm rate.

unknown_detector_complement.advisory_banner: ADVISORY SIDE-STUDY ONLY (SYNTHETIC / SIMULATION): Outputs an unsupervised anomaly_score (a relative statistical distance score) and an unknown_anomaly flag relative to synthetic train normal windows. Does NOT identify a physical hazard, does NOT assign a class, and adds +0.40 to +0.80 extra false-alarm episodes per normal run on test (+6.0 to +12.0 FA/h in sensor time).
